verdict.rationale: Kit's docs reference editors for emails that use a saved brand color palette, broadcasts carry an associated email template, collaborative editing is listed, and custom-field keys work as personalization tags in broadcasts and sequences. The visual editor and reusable templates are only implied, and cross-client rendering is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: explicit visual drag-and-drop editor documentation, a reusable template library/creation workflow, evidence that rendering is correct across email clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
